feed.title: The Filing Desk
feed.subtitle: Company results, read from the SEC filings

entry.title: Netflix's operating margin rises to 29.5% as revenue grows 15.9% to $45.2 billion
entry.summary: Revenue grew 15.9% to $45.2 billion and operating margin widened to 29.5%. Free cash flow rose 36.7% to $9.5 billion, and buybacks took 96% of it.

entry.title: Reddit revenue rose 53% to $895 million in Q3 as operating margin widened to 29.3%
entry.summary: Revenue grew 53.0% to $895 million and operating margin reached 29.3%. Net income rose 73.6% to $283 million and free cash flow nearly doubled to $363 million.

entry.title: Sandisk's sales rose 378% to $11 billion in a quarter. Its shares fell 13.5% anyway
entry.summary: A record quarter, an outlook above forecasts and an eight-for-one stock split. On the first trading day after the results, the shares fell 13.5%. Here is what the filings show and what the market focused on.

entry.title: Reddit's sales rose 53%, but Google is sending it fewer visitors, and its shares fell 29.2%
entry.summary: Reddit had one of its best quarters. Then its chief executive said search traffic was dropping by more than 1 million referrals a week, and the shares fell 29.2% on Friday.

entry.title: Intel's shares fell 28.6% after it warned a memory shortage will keep shrinking PC sales
entry.summary: Intel beat its own forecast for the quarter. Then it said a memory shortage would keep PC sales falling into 2027, and on Friday its shares fell 28.6%.

entry.title: AMD's shares fell 10.88% after Intel's PC warning. What AMD's own filings show before it reports
entry.summary: Intel said it sees the PC slowdown lasting at least through the first half of next year, and AMD's shares fell 10.88% on Friday, news reports said. AMD reports on November 3; its last 10-Q shows how much of its business rides on PCs.

entry.title: Amazon spent $77.3 billion on AI in a quarter, and its free cash flow is $42.4 billion in the red
entry.summary: AWS grew 39% and Amazon says it will grow faster still. But the cash its business makes no longer covers what it builds, so it is borrowing to pay.

entry.title: Alphabet revenue rose 25% to $127.6 billion while net income fell 24%
entry.summary: Revenue rose 24.7% to $127.6 billion and operating income rose 29.9%, but net income fell 24.3% after an investment loss. Capital spending of $51.4 billion left free cash flow negative.

entry.title: Microsoft revenue rose 19% to $92.3 billion as capital spending doubled to $39.4 billion
entry.summary: Revenue grew 18.8% to $92.3 billion and net income 32.0%, helped by a swing in OpenAI results. Capital spending more than doubled to $39.4 billion, so free cash flow fell 27.4% to $18.6 billion.

entry.title: ServiceNow revenue rose 20.5%; net income fell 45% in its first full quarter with Armis
entry.summary: Revenue grew 20.5% to $4.1 billion, but net income fell 44.8% to $277 million as amortization from its acquisitions and interest on new debt rose. Debt was $7.5 billion at September 30, against $1.5 billion a year earlier.

entry.title: Alphabet spent $51.4 billion on AI infrastructure in a quarter, and sold shares and bonds to pay
entry.summary: Google Cloud more than doubled its revenue. But Alphabet now spends more than its business brings in, and it is raising money from investors rather than buying back their shares.

entry.title: PayPal revenue rose 2% to $8.6 billion in the third quarter as net income fell 14%
entry.summary: Revenue grew 2.0% to $8.6 billion, but operating income fell 7.8% and net income fell 14.0%. Free cash flow was $1.4 billion, and buybacks cut the diluted share count by 10.6%.

entry.title: Boeing revenue rose 3.9% to $24.2 billion in the third quarter, with an operating profit
entry.summary: Revenue rose 3.9% to $24.2 billion and Boeing made an operating profit of $354 million, against a loss of $4.8 billion a year earlier. Free cash flow was $464 million.

entry.title: SoFi earned a record $241 million. The loan-loss number its critics watch fell too
entry.summary: Seven months after a short seller said SoFi's loans look safer than they are, its third quarter set records, and both of its loss measures came down. The hardest question is still open.

entry.title: IBM revenue rose 4.7% to $17.1 billion in the third quarter; net income rose 25.6%
entry.summary: Revenue rose 4.7% to $17.1 billion and net income rose 25.6% to $2.2 billion, helped by a lower tax charge. Free cash flow was $3.7 billion, up 30.6%.

entry.title: Meta's AI bill: cash flowing out, a new stock with no vote, and the Nasdaq's worst day since June
entry.summary: Meta spent more on data centers than its business brought in, then created a class of shares that can raise money without costing Mark Zuckerberg control. Tesla went the other way. Investors didn't like either.

entry.title: Accenture raised buybacks 63% and paid out 99% of its free cash flow
entry.summary: Revenue grew 6.5% to $74.2 billion and operating margin rose to 15.4%. Accenture spent $11.5 billion on buybacks and dividends, 99% of its free cash flow, and ended the year with $10.1 billion of debt.

entry.title: United Airlines revenue grew in the third quarter, but higher fuel costs cut its margin
entry.summary: Revenue grew 17.4% to $17.9 billion and net income rose 8.4% to $1.0 billion. Operating margin fell to 8.1% and operating cash flow dropped to $465 million.

entry.title: Meta revenue rose 26% to $64.6 billion, but a legal charge cut operating income 37%
entry.summary: Revenue rose 26.1% to $64.6 billion, while operating income fell 36.8% to $13.0 billion after a $9.89 billion legal charge. Capital spending of $33.9 billion left free cash flow negative.

entry.title: Tesla's revenue held flat in the third quarter as operating income fell by more than half
entry.summary: Revenue was $28.0 billion, down 0.2% from a year earlier. Operating income fell 55.8% to $718 million as research spending rose 69.4%, and capital spending more than doubled to $4.7 billion.
